item.title: Sneak Peek – Shaw Concepts ARC Helmet Cover
item.description: After years of teasing, the ARC Helmet Cover will launch soon. The ARC Helmet Cover will launch in MARPAT Woodland, MARPAT Desert, MultiCam, Ranger Green, M81, MC Tropic and MC Arid. It will fit OpsCore SF Fasts (both Next Gen and the Gen prior) as well as USMC ECHs. Coming soon from shaw-concepts.com.
